name: Northampton
summary: HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE WMS and dataset documentation provide first-party national cadastral-source evidence for England and Wales, including Northampton's location within the advertised extent. WFS is disabled and WMS GetFeatureInfo is non-queryable, so no anonymous parcel ID/geometry sample was retained.

queryOutcomes.query: Northampton England official cadastral parcel map GIS API land parcels
queryOutcomes.outcome: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons, official WMS, and licensed National Polygon Service documentation found.

queryOutcomes.query: Northampton England official cadastral parcel map GIS API land parcels (English is the UK's local administrative language)
queryOutcomes.outcome: Equivalent English-language first-party HM Land Registry sources found; no distinct local-language UK cadastral source was applicable.

requestOutcomes.request: GET official HM Land Registry WMS GetCapabilities
requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200; CP.CadastralParcel advertised with CRS:84/EPSG:27700 and national extent.

requestOutcomes.request: GET official HM Land Registry WFS GetCapabilities
requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 service exception: Service WFS is disabled.

requestOutcomes.request: GET bounded WMS GetFeatureInfo around exact WUP point
requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 service exception: LayerNotQueryable; no feature data retained.

requestOutcomes.request: GET official National Polygon Service page
requestOutcomes.outcome: Official documentation states full polygons are chargeable/licensed and require account access; authentication was not attempted.

nativeFieldMapping.INSPIRE_ID_or_POLY_ID: documented native polygon identity, not returned in an anonymous feature response and therefore not retained
nativeFieldMapping.Title_No: documented in licensed National Polygon Dataset technical specification; not requested because it is a title-linked field and no feature response was available

scopeLimits: National metadata does not prove municipal completeness for Northampton.
INSPIRE polygons are indicative registered-property extents, not definitive legal boundaries.
Exact-point query failure/non-queryability is not evidence of citywide absence.
No unsafe attributes were requested; no credentials or bypasses were used.
This packet does not admit a runtime source or constitute source integration.
uncertainty: The first-party custodian and service are clear, but anonymous feature-level access was unavailable in the checked endpoints. Dataset access, current local-authority download URL, feature identity, completeness, and runtime suitability require serial review.
serialReviewRecommendation: Hold. Independently verify authorized public download/API access, Northampton local-authority coverage, INSPIRE identity stability, CRS/axis handling, indicative-boundary semantics, and runtime admissibility before enabling an adapter.
